name: uxr-accessible-sessions
description: Plans research sessions disabled people and older users can take part in, with recruiting on purpose, access needs asked in advance, their own assistive technology, consent in accessible formats, session adjustments and an analysis note on not generalising. Use for "run uxr-accessible-sessions", "include disabled participants", "accessible research sessions", "screen reader users in testing", "access needs for participants", "research with older users", "no disabled person in the sessions", part of the UX Research with Claude Pack by 90n.
